build_model_minicpmv4_6: build a MiniCPMV4_6ForConditionalGeneration model for multimodal image and video generation tasks
extract_image_features: extract image features from pixel values using the get_image_features method with target sizes
extract_video_features: extract video features from NaViT-packed pixel values using the get_video_features method
run_vision_encoder: run the MiniCPMV4_6VisionModel encoder on pixel values with configurable ViT window merger and downsampling
configure_merger: configure the MiniCPMV4_6Merger to downsample vision features into LLM embedding space with multiple merge rounds
